doc: Walks a singly-linked list of "link" records reachable via a back-pointer stored 8 bytes before the current s0 pointer (record_base+0x18, since s0 == record_base+0x20). For each S_80045C34 record (pointed to by a2) whose flags field at 0x14 doesn't have bit 0x80 set, calls func_80045CC4(s0, a1, a2, a2->unk6), then reads the pointer field at D_80083160[0]+0x8D0 and passes it to func_80045310; if that returns nonzero the function returns 0 immediately. Otherwise it follows the link record's next pointer (offset 0x18 relative to base, i.e. *(s0-8)), refreshing s0 (=next+0x20), a1 (=next->unk8, an int) and a2 (=next->unkC, an S_80045C34*) from the new link record, and loops. Returns 0 when the list is exhausted or the func_80045310 check fires.
